Bill.BriefDescription: Reconvening an Alaskan Way viaduct and Seattle Seawall replacement project expert review panel.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reconvening the Alaskan Way viaduct and SeattleSeawall replacement project expert review panel; and adding a newsection to chapter 47.01 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall reconvene an expert review panel as described under RCW 47.01.400 for the purpose of updating the work that waspreviously completed by the panel on the Alaskan Way viaduct andSeattle Seawall replacement project and to ensure that an appropriateand viable financial plan is created and regularly reviewed. Theexpert review panel must be selected cooperatively by the chairs of thesenate and house of representatives transportation committees, thesecretary of transportation, the speaker of the house ofrepresentatives, the majority leader of the senate, and the governor.The expert review panel must report updated findings andrecommendations to the transportation committees of the legislature andthe governor's Alaskan Way viaduct program oversight committee bySeptember 1, 2011, and every six months thereafter until the project is p. 1 SB 5785operationally complete. Upon receipt of the expert review panel'supdated findings and recommendations, the governor must determinewhether the financial plan for the Alaskan Way viaduct and SeattleSeawall replacement project is feasible and sufficient to complete theproject as described in the final environmental impact statement.
